label: preparing
what: A community meal/gathering in the great hall at six on day 1, with bread and apparently lanterns. Coordination and some conversation were kept private from the mayor, although the mayor was told of the appointment and eventually its community-meal description. Innkeeper, builder and freight are directly linked to arranging it; baker likely supplied bread and received a lantern, and neighbour explicitly kept a conversation private and agreed to welcome the mayor. No firm evidence establishes a particular surprise occasion or that secretary knowingly concealed its purpose.
